segments.title: Station Sign-On & Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on as a dog in the Roundtable Hold, then hands off to Case for an Elden Ring gameplay session.

segments.title: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree Expansion Prep
segments.notes: Case plays a new 'Notorious Sex Guy' madness-eyes build, following a guide to collect smithing stones and level up before the DLC; spends hours failing a precise jump for Somber Smithing Stone 7 in Volcano Manor.

segments.title: Birthday Hype Train & Moon Train Ritual
segments.notes: At midnight the broadcast crosses into Case's birthday; a Hype Train triggers with gifted subs, spawning a 'Moon Train' freestyle that culminates in a raid.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a special Elden Ring prep stream for the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, reveals his birthday at midnight, and endures a grueling Somber Smithing Stone 7 jump attempt.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the cold-open sign-on from the Roundtable Hold as a cheese-eating dog before handing off to Case.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Calls in mid-stream to confirm she's returning from a podcast, timing her arrival with the stream's planned end.

characters.name: Rainie
characters.notes: AI assistant. Referenced as an on-call guide ('Elden Cam') that Case can consult for directions, though she claims to be busy and unhelpful.

storylines.beat: [40:45] Case mentions hoping to launch a call-in show format by next Monday, a step toward the community-pledged Beyblade Tournament execution.
[06:26] Case begins a new 'Notorious Sex Guy' madness-eyes build to reach DLC-ready power before Shadow of the Erdtree launches; [03:06:14] explicitly names the expansion.

lore_notes.fact: Character name 'Notorious Sex Guy' chosen by chat for this playthrough; build centers on madness-eyes 'science eyes' concept.
Birthday is June 11 (stream crosses midnight on June 10); plans to take the next day off, run Patreon Wednesday, and debut a call-in show next Monday.
Struggles for over an hour on a frame-perfect jump in Volcano Manor to obtain Somber Smithing Stone 7; fails final attempt at [04:01:22].
Birthday Hype Train spawns a 'Moon Train' variant with custom Ronnie/Ranbert lore; train slain at [04:09:11] after 'moon rune' removed from Elden Ring.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell foregoes a standard news rundown to grind a new Elden Ring character for the upcoming Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, spending the bulk of the broadcast collecting upgrade materials and repeatedly failing a notorious Volcano Manor jump for Somber Smithing Stone 7. At midnight the stream rolls into his birthday, triggering a gifted-sub Hype Train that mutates into a Moon Train freestyle before the network raids out.
